_about: Proposed SSYS-050 rows for indentation (pm7-editor-customizer, 2026-10-14; PROPOSAL-canon.md section 3b). Canon has no editor tab-size row, and the editor hard-coded four spaces: a 2-space file's guides fell on every other level and Tab put in 4. Inventory shape; build.py's EDITOR_LOOK_ROWS block admits a row until canon holds its id.

rows.label: Tab Size
rows.desc: How many columns a level of indentation is. Tab moves to the next level and Backspace in the indentation goes back one; a file's tabs open this wide. A file with indentation of its own keeps it while Follow the File's Indentation is on.

rows.label: Indent With
rows.desc: What a new level of indentation is made of in a file that doesn't already say: spaces, or a tab. Show Spaces marks a tab as an arrow.

rows.label: Follow the File's Indentation
rows.desc: A file indented with 2 spaces keeps 2 and one indented with tabs keeps tabs, whatever Tab Size and Indent With say. The editor reads it from the file's own lines (and, in the app, its .editorconfig).
